resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The While Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Time to move on to the second of our three loop statements, [b]while[/b]. 

The [b]while [/b]loop repeats through a block of code, but only as long as a specified condition is [b]true[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]Here's the syntax:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="js" ][b]while[/b] (condition) {    
   code block
}[/code]
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
The [b]condition [/b]can be any conditional statement that returns true or false.[/note]

Ok, we've got the theory, let's look at a real example:

好了，我们已经有了理论，让我们看看一个真实的例子。

content.text:
从代码描述可知，只要`i`小于或等于`10`，这段代码中的循环将继续运行。而且每次循环运行时，变量`i`都会增加`1`。

这将在页面输出并打印从`0`到`10`的数值。
content.text_html:
The loop in this code will continue to run as long as i is less than, or equal to, 10. And each time the loop runs, it will increase by 1.

This will output the values from 0 to 10.

只要i小于或等于10，这段代码中的循环将继续运行。而且每次循环运行时，都会增加1。

这将输出从0到10的数值。

content.text: 编写条件时要小心。如果一个条件总是为`true`，那么这个循环就会永远运行下去，也就是：**死循环**。
content.text_html:
Heads up! Be careful when writing conditions. If a condition is always true, the loop will run forever!

头条新闻！ 编写条件时要小心。如果一个条件总是为真，那么这个循环就会永远运行下去。

resolved.title: 计时器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写一个**程序-计时器**。

输入一个数字，作为秒数并向控制台输出所有的秒数，直到计时器停止。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The while loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Write a [b]program-timer[/b], that will take the count of seconds as input and output to the console all the seconds until timer stops.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
4
[b]
Sample Output[/b]
4
3
2
1
0

[note]Be attentive, 0 should also be included in the output.
[/note]

resolved.title: 避免死循环
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The While Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Endless loops are not good. And one way of this happening is if we forget to increase the variable used in the condition.
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
Make sure that the condition in a [b]while[/b] loop eventually becomes [b]false[/b].[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The While Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Endless loops are not good. And one way of this happening is if we forget to increase the variable used in the condition.
[note][b]Heads up![/b]
Make sure that the condition in a [b]while[/b] loop eventually becomes [b]false[/b].[/note]

content.text:
无休止的执行循环是不好的。如果我们忘记重新赋值条件中的变量，那么就有可能会发行死循环

当然，我们要避免发生这样的事情。
content.text_html:
Endless loops are not good. And one way of this happening is if we forget to increase the variable used in the condition.

无休止的循环是不好的。发生这种情况的一种方式是，如果我们忘记增加条件中使用的变量。

content.text: 因此需要确保`while`循环中的条件最终变成`false`。
content.text_html:
Heads up! Make sure that the condition in a while loop eventually becomes false.

头条新闻！ 确保while循环中的条件最终变成false。
